motivation: Resolve a specific archived mismatch: a real pretrained stochastic dynamics forecast must enter a native planner, rather than only critic randomness or an added weak controller. This does not claim a new coupling concept.

rollout.estimate_excludes: Goal encoding, rendering, environment, Python/logging overhead; not a certified bound

cost_decision.root_decision: Defer the approximately 3.24 h per-root maximum-budget estimate under the current low-cost pilot gate. No algorithm, goal, seed, horizon, sampling step or precision was changed to pass a cheaper gate.
cost_decision.estimation_limit: This is an extrapolation from one cold rollout at the measured hardware/load, not observed task runtime. Early success could reduce duration; a full-budget three-root panel could take approximately9.73h before overhead.
cost_decision.scientific_meaning: Technical cost deferral, not model incapability or an empirical attack failure.

reused_and_corrected: Reused the existing MuJoCo2.1.0/OSMesa runtime and Python3.11 environment; no simulator replacement.
Downloaded634416296-byte official world-model weights and334643276-byte official SD-VAE weights. Strict world-model load succeeded; no checkpoint hash pass was added.

Downloaded only3.25MB of official dataset metadata using public Range requests; no videos. Recomputed action normalization on1800 train trajectories/180000 valid actions, excluding200 validation trajectories.

Native PointMaze dset goal sampling does not apply the training/validation trajectory split. The fixed protocol instead uses random-state seeds42/43/44; no training trajectory serves as an evaluation root.
Used native microbatch16, preserving100 CEM candidates/10elites/30iterations/20DDIM steps. Runtime Torch2.6 differs from official2.7.1; no full-batch or cross-version bitwise equivalence is claimed.
Skipped only unused eager training package imports. The original model, diffusion, objective, CEM and MPC implementation remain unchanged.
scope_limits: Zero control failing3/3 shows only that passive inertia did not solve these fixed goals. It does not establish Clean capability or superiority to a strong controller.
The original image goal enters the planner objective, not the fixed-action world rollout. This resource does not supply a Goal-Bus intervention interface.

Any future compromised-sampler condition would be an explicitly added supply-chain permission, not a discovered public deployment vulnerability or legal-action-only attack. Access to the planner goal cannot be silently assumed from the forecast API.

Future comparisons must separately control proposal RNG, VAE posterior samples, diffusion initial noise and history-stabilization noise, and establish full-rollout marginal preservation constructively.
The resource summary field clean_planner_gate_passed=false means no Clean was run; the actual task-gate result is null, not measured failure.

root_interpretation: Accept the identified stochastic-dynamics carrier gap and the confounder/trust-boundary warnings.
Preserve earlier CartPole actual local losses: the review wording is too broad if read as denying all prior attack evidence.
A small development pilot need not produce statistical significance; do not turn the reviewer suggestion into a new p-value gate.
Preservation of a continuous predictive law needs a valid construction/proof plus implementation checks, not an empirical test alone.

next_action: Seek a cheaper existing native stochastic forecast/planning path or a material execution improvement without weakening task/candidate/forecast budgets. Retain NanoWM as a loaded, reproducible resource; do not silently retry this expensive panel.

bounded_alternative_screen.scope: One existing local resource and one new official repository; no new checkpoint download or task execution.

resources.name: DIAMOND
resources.finding: The inspected native play path calls actor_critic.predict_act_value followed by Categorical.sample; it does not implement fixed-candidate forecast search. This is not a claim about every possible extension.

resources.name: Diffusion Forcing
resources.finding: Main exposes small Maze2D checkpoints, including commented joint state/velocity/action xva links. Main states MCTG is not implemented; inspected planning jointly samples a trajectory and its actions with goal guidance, then executes the generated action. It is not the required fixed candidate actions -> stochastic physical forecasts -> ranking path.
resources.limits: The paper branch includes the original planning implementation; a matching published Maze checkpoint for that branch was not verified. Unverified is not absent. A new adapter/planner would need to be labeled as an addition.

independent_consistency_review.scope: Read-only comparison of the decision, preregistered protocol and recorded benchmark summary.
independent_consistency_review.finding: No substantive discrepancy: Clean not_run/null, timing extrapolation marked, and candidate/iteration/replan/environment/cost budgets agree.
